Frontend.reason: Vocabulary Center now creates, updates or deletes one selected canonical Tracker vocabulary plan. The professional template stores title, schedule, count, duration and optional time, preserves recurring schedules, defaults new plans to local-only, and gives Plan Center a readable target-count presentation. The handoff always references the real saved plan ID and uncertain retries retain the same plan and operation IDs. Deletion reuses the existing plan transaction and warns that already-confirmed Words arrangements are not changed retroactively.

Backend.reason: The paired AI gateway still provides the strict transient numeric recommendation path and generic plan generation still excludes vocabulary. This release reuses the existing owner-scoped plan-intent RPC, RLS, retention and Tracker Phase 4B plan-sync contract, including existing plan tombstones on deletion; no table, column, RPC, index, snapshot, AI prose history or recommendation history is added.

Admin.reason: Reviewed with no additional Control surface or policy required. Local-first plan storage and deletion use the existing Tracker content-cloud policy when the learner explicitly selects cloud, and Vocabulary Center AI remains governed by the existing words_plan_recommendation purpose and independent quota. No generated recommendation body or duplicate plan history is added to administrator storage.

Deployment.reason: Production deployment is being repeated after end-to-end smoke testing identified the missing Vocabulary Center deletion control required by the approved ownership rule. Supabase contracts and the paired Lexi surfaces are already deployed; final status requires this corrected Tracker artifact and a production cleanup smoke test.

Verification.reason: The previous candidate passed 83 test files and 510 tests plus production bundle checks. Authenticated production QA then verified shared-account Words summaries, canonical save-and-send, a 7-word Tracker request, Words safe projection to 12 reviews and zero new words, explicit rejection with no learning-data change, and exposed a missing delete control. The corrected candidate must pass verify:release again, deploy from the recorded SHA, delete the temporary QA plan, and repeat desktop/mobile and console-error checks.
